annotations.title: News about a person or organization

description: Return 787daily articles that mention a specific named entity (person, organization, or place), newest first. Match is on the entity's full canonical name; case and accents are ignored ('jenniffer gonzalez' finds Jenniffer González). A short name that finds little suggests the fuller names in didYouMean ('LUMA' suggests 'LUMA Energy'). Returns { name, count (every match), returned, articles[] (at most limit, default 20), didYouMean? }.

limit.description: How many articles to return, newest first (default 20)

name.description: Entity name to search for, e.g. 'LUMA Energy', 'Jenniffer González'

since.description: Only articles published that day or later, YYYY-MM-DD

name: get_by_entity
title: News about a person or organization
